content.title: Philadelphia 76ers vs Charlotte Hornets Live Stream: How to Watch NBA
content.text: Charlotte is on the charge up the Eastern Conference standings and has Philadelphia in its sights as the two franchises collide on Saturday. Home comforts have served Charlotte well of late, and Charles Lee is hoping to take his team to a sixth straight win when they host Philadelphia at the Spectrum Center on Saturday. Both teams are hunting down a playoff spot as the regular season rounds to a close, and Saturday’s result in North Carolina could have a huge impact in deciding which of these teams (if either) secures a top-six finish in the conference. Each of these franchises already boast victory over one another so far this season, with Charlotte triumphing 130-93 when they last faced off here back in January. How to Watch 76ers vs Hornets Today Game Date: March 28, 2026 Start Time: 6 p.m. ET Location: Spectrum Center, Charlotte, North Carolina TV: FanDuel Sports Network Extra (South) Live stream the 76ers vs Hornets game on Fubo: Start watching now! The Hornets continue to keep alive their chances of finishing in the Eastern Conference’s playoff places after blazing to a fifth straight win when they met the New York Knicks on Thursday night. Kon Knueppel came within two assists of recording his first career triple-double and continues to advance his claim for this season’s Rookie of the Year award. He also broke the record for youngest player in NBA history to reach 250 three-pointers (he now has 253) and is one weapon Philadelphia would be wise to keep tabs on: The playoff hunt in the Eastern is particularly spicy at this late stage of the season, with every team between sixth and 10th place separated by a single win as things stand. Charlotte is raising its voice in that conversation despite being sat ninth, and a sixth straight win at the Spectrum Center would lift it level with Philadelphia with only a handful of games remaining. The 76ers lost their first five road fixtures in March but have now pieced together back-to-back wins on their travels, though Charlotte will be a tougher host than either of Sacramento or Utah. Joel Embiid impressed with 35 points in Wednesday’s win over Chicago but is now day-to-day with an oblique injury, adding to an injury list that already includes Tyrese Maxey and Kelly Oubre Jr. What Time Is 76ers vs Hornets?
